mythology: Sati's upper lip fell on the Mahur hills; also the sacred ground where sage Jamadagni lived, where Renuka Mata arose, and where Lord Dattatreya took birth.
pilgrimage_significance: One of the three and a half Shakti Peethas of Maharashtra; revered as the primary seat of Matri-seva (filial devotion) and Parashurama upasana.
historical_notes: Described in Devi Bhagavata Purana and Guru Charitra as a living teertha where Lord Dattatreya rests every afternoon and begs for alms.
